name: power_governor
desc: 查看/设置CPU idle与电源管理策略
cmd: [ -n $gov ] && echo $gov > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuidle/current_governor 2>&1; echo -n 'cpuidle_gov='; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuidle/current_governor 2>/dev/null; echo '--- idle states ---'; ls /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/ 2>/dev/null
